stanzas.sanskrit:
रामसखः क्वापि दिने
कामद भगवन् गतो भवान्विपिनम् ।
सूनुभिरपि गोपानां
धेनुभिरभिसंवृतो लसद्वेषः ॥ ५७-१ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna, the fulfiller of all wishes, one day dressed in best attire, went to the forest together with Balarama and Gopas surrounded by cows.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
rāmasakhaḥ kvāpi dine
kāmada bhagavan gato bhavānvipinam |
sūnubhirapi gopānāṃ
dhenubhirabhisaṃvṛto lasadveṣaḥ || 57-1 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
सन्दर्शयन् बलाय
स्वैरं बृन्दावनश्रियं विमलाम् ।
काण्डीरैः सह बालै-
र्भाण्डीरकमागमो वटं क्रीडन् ॥ ५७-२ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna happily showed the scenic beauty of the Vrindavana to Balarama, and with a playful mood reached the Bhandareeka(Banyan) tree.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
sandarśayan balāya
svairaṃ bṛndāvanaśriyaṃ vimalām |
kāṇḍīraiḥ saha bālai-
rbhāṇḍīrakamāgamo vaṭaṃ krīḍan || 57-2 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
तावत्तावकनिधन-
स्पृहयालुर्गोपमूर्तिरदयालुः ।
दैत्यः प्रलम्बनामा
प्रलम्बबाहुं भवन्तमापेदे ॥ ५७-३ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: At that time, a demon came there in disguise of a gopa, in an intention to kill Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tāvattāvakanidhana-
spṛhayālurgopamūrtiradayāluḥ |
daityaḥ pralambanāmā
pralambabāhuṃ bhavantamāpede || 57-3 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
जानन्नप्यविजान-
-न्निव तेन समं निबद्धसौहार्दः ।
वटनिकटे पटु-
-पशुपव्याबद्धं द्वन्द्वयुद्धमारब्धाः ॥ ५७-४ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna quickly recognizing him and his motive, acted innocent and welcomed him and allowed him to be a part of the group in their game.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
jānannapyavijāna-
-nniva tena samaṃ nibaddhasauhārdaḥ |
vaṭanikaṭe paṭu-
-paśupavyābaddhaṃ dvandvayuddhamārabdhāḥ || 57-4 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
गोपान् विभज्य तन्वन्
सङ्घं बलभद्रकं भवत्कमपि ।
त्वद्बलभीरुं दैत्यं
त्वद्बलगतमन्वमन्यथा भगवन् ॥ ५७-५ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Krishna divided the cowherd boys into two teams to play a game of fight. One group headed by Krishna and the other by Balaraama. Pralambasura joined Krishna's group as he was aware of Krishna's power.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
gopān vibhajya tanvan
saṅghaṃ balabhadrakaṃ bhavatkamapi |
tvadbalabhīruṃ daityaṃ
tvadbalagatamanvamanyathā bhagavan || 57-5 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
कल्पितविजेतृवहने
समरे परयूथगं स्वदयिततरम् ।
श्रीदामानमधत्थाः
पराजितो भक्तदासतां प्रथयन् ॥ ५७-६ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: The condition of the game was that whoever wins should be carried on back by the loser. Krishna having lost to his dearest friend Sridhaama carried him on his back, showing his affection for his devotees.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
kalpitavijetṛvahane
samare parayūthagaṃ svadayitataram |
śrīdāmānamadhatthāḥ
parājito bhaktadāsatāṃ prathayan || 57-6 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
एवं बहुषु विभूमन्
बालेषु वहत्सु वाह्यमानेषु ।
रामविजितः प्रलम्बो
जहार तं दूरतो भवद्भीत्या ॥ ५७-७ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: And then many cowherd boys were carrying and were being carried. Balarama defeated Pralambasura who then carried Balarama on his back and went long distance away from Krishna.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
evaṃ bahuṣu vibhūman
bāleṣu vahatsu vāhyamāneṣu |
rāmavijitaḥ pralambo
jahāra taṃ dūrato bhavadbhītyā || 57-7 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
त्वद्दूरं गमयन्तं
तं दृष्ट्वा हलिनि विहितगरिमभरे ।
दैत्यः स्वरूपमागा-
-द्यद्रूपात् स हि बलोऽपि चकितोऽभूत् ॥ ५७-८ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Balarama increased his weight slowly by his divine power. Unable to bear Balarama's weight for long, Pralambasura also took his actual form that made Balarama also shocked.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
tvaddūraṃ gamayantaṃ
taṃ dṛṣṭvā halini vihitagarimabhare |
daityaḥ svarūpamāgā-
-dyadrūpāt sa hi balo’pi cakito’bhūt || 57-8 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
उच्चतया दैत्यतनो-
-स्त्वन्मुखमालोक्य दूरतो रामः ।
विगतभयो दृढमुष्ट्या
भृशदुष्टं सपदि पिष्टवानेनम् ॥ ५७-९ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Pralambasura’s height was like a mountain and so being carried on his shoulder, Balaraam could see Krishna from a distance. Then seeing Krishna from far, he came out of his fear and hit his head with his mighty fist. Pralambasura was crushed to death.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
uccatayā daityatano-
-stvanmukhamālokya dūrato rāmaḥ |
vigatabhayo dṛḍhamuṣṭyā
bhṛśaduṣṭaṃ sapadi piṣṭavānenam || 57-9 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
हत्वा दानववीरं
प्राप्तं बलमालिलिङ्गिथ प्रेम्णा ।
तावन्मिलतोर्युवयोः
शिरसि कृता पुष्पवृष्टिरमरगणैः ॥ ५७-१० ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Balarama returned back victoriously after killing asura. Krishna embraced his brother. The devas and Gods, showered flowers on them.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
hatvā dānavavīraṃ
prāptaṃ balamāliliṅgitha premṇā |
tāvanmilatoryuvayoḥ
śirasi kṛtā puṣpavṛṣṭiramaragaṇaiḥ || 57-10 ||

stanzas.sanskrit:
आलम्बो भुवनानां
प्रालम्बं निधनमेवमारचयन् ।
कालं विहाय सद्यो
लोलम्बरुचे हरे हरेः क्लेशान् ॥ ५७-११ ॥
stanzas.commentary_en: Bhattathiri praised Bhagwan who is the supporter of the three worlds and the one who perfectly executed the plan to kill Pralambasura to protect his devotees without delay and requested to eradicate his sufferings soon.
stanzas.stanza_roman:
ālambo bhuvanānāṃ
prālambaṃ nidhanamevamāracayan |
kālaṃ vihāya sadyo
lolambaruce hare hareḥ kleśān || 57-11 ||
